plainLanguage: Round Rock is on the 2024 codes: the 2024 International Residential Code, 2024 energy code (climate zone 2A), 2024 International Plumbing Code and 2023 electrical code. Most new homes are in planned developments (PUDs) whose own setbacks override the base SF-2 district, so your plat and PUD rules come first. Base SF-2 lots are about 6,500 sq ft; typical setbacks of about 25 ft front and 5 ft side are still unconfirmed. The building permit is a flat $485, plus $520 for the meter and line. Impact fees are the big cost: about $4,900 water, $2,900 wastewater and about $3,200 roadway, roughly $11,000 per home. Near creeks, the slab must be at least 2 ft above the city's fully developed 100-year floodplain.
